en-US.PRACTICE_HINT: Bind a key to a difficulty and a pitch. Both land between attempts, never mid-run: difficulty is held until the current attempt ends, and pitch is written into the level's own Pitch setting once, exactly as if you typed it in. The readout shows anything still queued with an arrow.
en-US.DESC_PRACTICE_ADD: Adds another key binding. Up to 16.
en-US.DESC_PRACTICE_KEY: Press any key to bind it. Escape cancels.
en-US.DESC_PRACTICE_SHOWINDICATOR: Draws the difficulty the game is actually on, which the in-game selector does not always keep up to date.
en-US.DESC_PRACTICE_SHOWSPEED: Shows the level's current Pitch next to the difficulty.
